all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.
2 Chronicles 30:27
Quote of the Day
"Our belief in the Resurrection … encourages us to fulfill our family responsibilities in mortality. It helps us live together in love in this life."
President Dallin H. Oaks | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
